description: Build the Mission Control hero screen and its 4 glass sub-panels (ResourcePanel, EnvironmentPanel, EventPanel, AstroAIPanel) wired to real simulation data via useMissionControl, integrate Astro-AI, create an event-registry lookup, and wire the /mission route. The central area is a styled CSS base backdrop (starfield + SVG/Phosphor habitat) — NOT 3D (3D is a later phase). Depends on FEAT-001 (components), FEAT-002 (live decisionLog + initialResources + useAstroContext + getMissionSummary not strictly needed here but useAstroContext is), and FEAT-003 (event-registry is created here, not in 003). Build + all tests pass.
steps: src/features/events/event-registry.ts: import LUNAR_EVENTS from @simulation/events/lunar-events and MARTIAN_EVENTS from @simulation/events/martian-events; build a Map<string, EventDefinition>. Export getEventDefinition(eventId: string): EventDefinition | undefined and getEventsForPlanet(planetId: PlanetId): readonly EventDefinition[]. This file re-exports the existing event arrays for presentation lookup only (does NOT import the engine).

src/features/mission-control/ResourcePanel.tsx: read currentResources, initialResources (store, FEAT-002) and resourceHistory from useMissionControl. Render one ResourceBar each for oxygen/water/food/energy with status by threshold (crit < 10% of initialResources for oxygen/water/food; energy crit < 15%). Radiation dose as a StatReadout + status (warn >= RADIATION_HIGH_THRESHOLD_MSV, crit >= RADIATION_CRITICAL_THRESHOLD_MSV — import thresholds from @data/nasa/life-support-constants). Crew status line. When resourceHistory.length >= 2, render a small inline SVG sparkline per resource (no Recharts here). All data from selectors.

src/features/mission-control/EnvironmentPanel.tsx: read selectedPlanetId -> profile displayName + timeUnitLabel, currentMissionDay, crewSize, activeFaultStates. Derive solar status for PRESENTATION from data only (do NOT import SimulationClock/getSolarAvailabilityFactor): for Moon use profile.solarCycleDays/solarDayLength ((missionDay % solarCycleDays) < solarDayLength -> 'Lunar Day' else 'Lunar Night'); for Mars show nominal 'Sol cycle'. Show temperature range from profile.temperatureRange. Render StatusBadges (icon+label) for solar status, temperature, radiation trend, and each active fault state.

src/features/mission-control/EventPanel.tsx: read activeEventIds from useMissionControl. For each id, getEventDefinition(id) -> render an EventCard passing event.choices with onResolve(choiceId) -> resolveEvent(eventId, choiceId) (from useMissionControl). Skip ids with no definition gracefully. If activeEventIds is empty show an 'All systems nominal' Panel.

src/features/mission-control/AstroAIPanel.tsx: instantiate AstroAssistant once via useMemo/useRef reading import.meta.env.VITE_AI_API_KEY/VITE_AI_API_ENDPOINT/VITE_AI_MODEL (cast to string | undefined). Use useAstroContext() for the SimulationContext (null until mission active). Render the AstroPanel component; buttons 'Explain current situation' (assistant.explainEvent) and per-resource 'Why is X changing?' (assistant.explainResourceChange for oxygen/water/food/energy). Maintain messages: AstroResponse[] + isLoading; on click push the awaited Zod-validated response (the service validates). Reduced-motion via useReducedMotion. Disable buttons when context is null.

src/features/mission-control/MissionControlScreen.tsx: AppShell with a central CSS base backdrop (AppShell starfield + a stylized habitat illustration via inline SVG/Phosphor icons — NOT 3D). Dock glass HUD panels: ResourcePanel, EnvironmentPanel, EventPanel, AstroAIPanel. Top HUD (hudSlot or inline): mission-day counter, planet name, crew count, 'Advance Day' PrimaryButton (advanceDay()), 'End Mission' button (endMission() then useNavigate('/debrief')), reduce-motion toggle (AppShell). If globalError is set -> inline error Panel with a dismiss button (clearError from useAppStore). If missionOutcome !== 'ongoing' -> surface a banner + 'View Debrief' PrimaryButton -> /debrief. Keep under ~300 lines (sub-panels are separate files).

src/app/router.tsx: replace the /mission PlaceholderScreen with MissionControlScreen (EAGER import) inside the existing RequireSetup + RequireMission guards, wrapped in ScreenTransition. Other routes unchanged from FEAT-003.

tests/unit/features/MissionControlScreen.test.tsx (and sub-panel tests as needed): use the real store — set up a valid mission state, initializeMission(), and a couple advanceDay() calls in act(). Assert: 'Advance Day' calls advanceDay (currentMissionDay increments); an EventCard choice calls resolveEvent; 'End Mission' sets missionActive=false and navigates to /debrief; AstroAIPanel renders and the 'Explain current situation' button is present/enabled after mission start.
acceptance_criteria: event-registry maps event ids to definitions and is used by EventPanel (no engine import)

ResourcePanel shows real resources with correct status thresholds and optional sparklines; EnvironmentPanel shows planet/day/environment without importing the simulation clock; EventPanel renders active events with resolve wired; AstroAIPanel renders and calls AstroAssistant with Zod-validated fallback responses
MissionControlScreen composes all 4 panels + HUD with Advance Day / End Mission / reduce-motion toggle + globalError handling + outcome banner
MissionControlScreen + sub-panel tests pass; all existing tests remain green
verification: npm run build exits 0 with zero TS errors (and no src/simulation/ change)
npm run test -- --run passes (existing + new mission-control tests)
git diff --name-only shows no src/simulation/ path
